result:
If I could choose one change, I’d make a safe, loved childhood something everyone gets—not something anyone has to be lucky to have.

Not a childhood without disappointment or difficulty. One without hunger, terror, cruelty, or the need to earn affection by becoming someone else.

It wouldn’t solve everything. But so much suffering is passed along by people who were taught, very early, that the world is unsafe and love is conditional. I’d interrupt that inheritance.
